items.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
items.summary: VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.

items.title: Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
items.summary: More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.

items.title: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says
items.summary: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Muneeb Ali warned that uncertainty over Bitcoin’s quantum security could deter institutional investors.
